observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white PlayStation 5 console standing upright against a wooden slatted wall, placed on a black cushioned surface.
The console has a visible disc slot on its side (seen in photo 1), indicating this is the Disc Edition, not the Digital Edition.
A single white DualSense wireless controller is leaning against the base of the console in both photos; it shows some surface grime/dirt on the button area.
No power cable, HDMI cable, box, stand, or documentation is visible in either photo.
No serial number, label, model sticker, or region marking is visible anywhere on the console.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / EASY GAMES & GADGETS' overlays both images; no other identifying text is present.
